scope: cross-version migration path (src/CrossVersionMigrator.sol + StableStaker migration surface)

invariants.name: invariant_01_migratorTokenConservation
invariants.description: Per migrate() call the migrator's token balance delta is exactly zero and its allowance to the destination staker ends at exactly 0. Absolute balance equals the sum of external donations, proving nothing leaks into or out of the pass-through.
invariants.attacked_with: fuzzed batch composition/order, duplicate and already-migrated addresses, direct donations to the migrator

invariants.name: invariant_02_noOverMintAcrossTheHop
invariants.description: phUSD minted across BOTH stakers never exceeds the emission budget. Asserted against a loose cap (sum of rates * wall clock) and a tight cap (sum of rate*dt only over intervals in which a pool was Active AND held principal).
invariants.source: econ pass (analytic refutation) - this is the empirical cross-check

invariants.name: invariant_03_noDoubleCredit
invariants.description: No user holds a non-zero position on both stakers simultaneously, and no user's destination credit exceeds their frozen source snapshot credit.

invariants.name: testFuzz_04_creditIsOrderAndCompositionIndependent
invariants.description: With (R,P) frozen, delivered value per user is identical to the wei across batch composition, batch ordering, and migrate() vs userMigrate(). Verified by running two scenarios from the same EVM state via vm.snapshotState/vm.revertToState.

invariants.name: invariant_05_solvency
invariants.description: Sum of credits paid during a terminal migration (batch sweeps + self-exits) never exceeds that epoch's realized amount R; lifetime credits never exceed the sum of every epoch's R.

invariants.name: invariant_06_oldPoolAccountingConsistent
invariants.description: The source pool's totalStaked always equals the sum of live positions, and the staker set empties exactly when totalStaked reaches zero.

seededState: 6 real stakers per epoch with distinct, odd principals (real floor-division dust)
two tokens with different decimals (USDC 6dp under migration, DAI 18dp permanently Active on the destination)
a live below-par MockYieldStrategy on the SOURCE pool so R < P and every credit is a non-trivial pro-rata division
a live haircut-capable MockYieldStrategy on the DESTINATION pool so depositFor really routes
3 days of elapsed time before every snapshot so pending phUSD is non-zero
an actually-executed initiateMigration and an actually-executed non-empty migrate before fuzzing starts
repeated migration EPOCHS (finalizeAndReset + re-wire + re-stake + re-initiate) so the hop is replayed many times per run
antiVacuousness.tripwire: afterInvariant() fails loudly unless migrate calls > 0, non-empty migrate calls > 0, total migrated > 0, credits paid > 0, epochs started > 0, phUSD minted > 0 and emissions accrued > 0
antiVacuousness.sensitivityCheck: Two deliberate mutants were injected and BOTH were caught: (a) asserting the migrator's absolute balance is zero (fails on donations), (b) comparing per-user delivered value against reference+1 in the order-independence fuzz. The harness is demonstrably able to fail.
